Existing checkers independently validate exact manifest input/output membership and approved reference/baseline lineage.

during.timing: during check execution, not part of pre-run snapshot

auxiliaryDataTableFixture.qualification: The DataTable entry fixture was additionally observed during execution and after it, not before the six-command checkpoint. Product/reference build inputs retain the full before/after binding above; this auxiliary timing is not represented as a pre-run observation.

observations.reference: 109 tokens; 33 routes and 547 required regions; 14 workflow profiles, 139 browser cases and 390 keyboard cases; 66 responsive/accessibility cases; 66 controlled reference screenshot hashes matched the existing approved baseline.
observations.product: All 33 top-level boolean assertions true; no critical violations, reference-only pages or unexpected requests. Built-product matrix covers 8 workspaces x 3 viewports x 2 themes (48 cases), plus 6 designated lock/recovery/dialog cases; 10,000-row DataTable keeps 50 rows with tested keyboard transitions, focus and disabled boundaries.
observations.captures: The visual report records reference-fixture screenshot comparison, not product screenshots or a new baseline. Product evidence is the actual built renderer's functional/DOM/style measurements in the retained frame report.

adverseResults.qualification: No non-passing check occurred in this six-command run. Previously retained T03/T04 adverse evidence is not superseded. An agent/tool interruption delayed final snapshot/summary publication; completed checks were not replayed or relabeled.

safety.temporaryQualification: Existing built-frame checker internally builds its disposable interactive DataTable test bundle in its own temporary child; it does not rebuild product/reference/native outputs. Existing fixture cleanup is confined to that generated child.
safety.redaction: Durable summary is repository-relative and omits account/profile absolute paths and SIDs. Raw machine reports remain in their distinct local artifacts/tmp paths and are bound by raw SHA-256.

limits: Reference fixture parity does not establish native Windows dialog, actual Core/DPAPI/SQLCipher lifecycle or production packaging behavior.

Product Tauri IPC, directory chooser/default, Core responses, application-lock and support behavior use the checker's explicitly declared doubles; real Core is used only for the read-only workflow-catalog projection, not storage/service startup.
Passing style/functional checks does not resolve the separate paused A08 styling/return findings, approve a changed reference, satisfy independent T04 acceptance or approve release.
Broader integrated native, package and slice/exit qualification remains the root task's duty.
